name: Local Network Access
description: Lets other devices on your local network open BossMod in a web browser. They need the address and the access code shown here. The connection isn’t encrypted, so turn this on only for a network you trust.
summary: Open BossMod from other devices on your network.
author: JTechMinds LLC

settings.label: Network access
settings.help: Choose the port other devices use to reach BossMod. If another program already uses it, pick a different one.
